page.heading: Skills

empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

evals.title: Skill evals
evals.body: Scoring a skill against a fixture set is coming in a later lesson.

stats.title: Skill stats
stats.body: Usage and token-cost stats are coming in a later lesson.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.descriptionPlaceholder: Use when reviewing a pull request that touches database migrations…
config.descriptionHint: The description is this skill's interface. It is what an agent reads when deciding whether to pull the skill in, so write it directively — "Use when …" — rather than as a summary of the body.
config.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
config.tokensHint: Rough estimate of what this body costs in the assembled prompt.

previewTab.title: Rendered body
previewTab.note: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

empty.title: Nothing to preview
empty.body: This skill has an empty body.

versions.title: Version history
versions.note: Restoring an older body creates a NEW version — history is never rewritten.

empty.title: No history yet
empty.body: Versions appear here once you save an edit.

create.title: Create a skill
create.subtitle: A skill is configuration text — it is never executed, only added to the review prompt.

fields.name: Name
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Use when reviewing a pull request that touches database migrations…
fields.descriptionHint: The description is this skill's interface — an agent reads it to decide whether to pull the skill in. Write it directively ("Use when …").

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.
file.chooseHint: A .md skill file or a .zip skill bundle. Only Markdown is read — archive entries are listed, never unpacked and never executed.
file.badExtension: Only .md and .zip files can be imported.
file.trustTitle: Review this before you save it
file.trustBody: An imported skill is someone else's instructions going into your agent's prompt. Read the body below first — it is stored as untrusted data and stays yours to vet.
file.ignoredHint: These archive entries were listed and left alone — never unpacked, never executed.
file.unsaved: Nothing has been saved yet — this is a preview.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

listItem.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? This cannot be undone.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
